split_text_for_lm: split text into conditioning context and generation segments for language modeling
process_lm_example: process an example by splitting text into query and target for language modeling
evaluate_lm_prediction: evaluate a language model prediction using exact match, f1, and rouge scores
filter_lm_results: filter retrieved results by id to remove the passage being generated
init_lm_task: initialize a language modeling task with min words and context ratio options
